scene: The weaver's parchment map outlines three bustling transport routes leaving the meadows.
picture: Along level grass, a frost-rimed sleigh tram waits on twin rails on the far left. Left of centre, the boy in his orange puffer vest, scarf, and kite inspects the map stand. At centre, a glass-bottomed canal boat sits moored at a low pier. On the far right, a hillside chairlift platform hums.
shown: a frost-covered sleigh tram on rails waiting with doors open on far left
a glass-bottomed canal boat moored at a stone dock at centre
a swinging chairlift station with empty yellow benches on far right
